title: Agent Registry Entry Contract (v1)
description: Phase 28.A-0 / ADR-021 (APPROVED). Declares ONE agent entry in the single-source-of-truth Agent Registry. v1 scope: DECLARATION ONLY — no execution fields. This is the approved v1 subset of the ADR-021 field set: execution-phase fields (workflow, tools, skills, knowledge_dependencies, communication_policy, internal flag) arrive in a later versioned revision of this contract together with the 28.A-1+ implementation, never silently. Registry form: v1 = configuration based (code-resident declarations with fail-closed startup validation); runtime dynamic registry is FORBIDDEN (ADR-021 ruling). The Router consumes ONLY agent ids declared here.

id.description: Stable agent identifier (e.g. insurance-qa-agent). Referenced by RouterDecision.agent_id; must not collide across the registry.

description.description: What this agent is responsible for (business responsibility, not implementation detail).

supported_intents.description: Intents this agent may serve — a SUBSET of the v1 IntentResult vocabulary (ADR-019). At startup the registry validator fail-closes if any entry references an intent outside the vocabulary.

input_contract.description: Reference (path or URI) to the agent's input contract document/schema.

output_contract.description: Reference (path or URI) to the agent's output contract document/schema (e.g. artifact contract or answer contract).

capabilities.description: Machine-readable capability tags (e.g. knowledge-grounded-qa, planning-workflow). Used for governance/audit surfacing, not for routing logic (routing is intent-based only).

risk_level.description: Risk classification of this agent's actions. High-risk agents (e.g. planning, plan modification) are subject to the ADR-019 confidence floor and ADR-024 review linkage.
